Recommend ready_with_notes with the three open test-coverage items carried forward as improvement_suggestions for a future execution round.

evidence.title: Round-3 regex fix in source: pii_home_dir uses (?m)(?:^|[\t "])
evidence.description: pii_patterns.go:73 — pattern changed from `(?:\s|\")(?:/home/|/Users/)...` to `(?m)(?:^|[\t "])(?:/home/|/Users/)[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+`. Comment on lines 70-72 explicitly documents the fix: 'Using \s here would match the trailing \n of the previous line and misattribute the finding to line N-1.' The (?m) flag enables ^ to mean start-of-line in multiline input. Together with the non-newline separator class this ensures a path at column 1 of line N is matched without capturing the line break from line N-1.

Rounds 1-3 have all flagged these as the highest-risk timing guarantees in the plan and they remain uncovered by tests — only the oversize-file fast-skip path has a test today.

Also cover the 404-on-unknown-id branch. Currently only the active-map hit path is exercised by live probes. Raised in rounds 1-3 and still open.
